Identified 0.25 as a terminating decimal because it stops after two digits.
Converted 0.363636… to 4/11 and 0.1666… to 1/6 using algebraic subtraction.

end.parentNote: Ishaan practised classifying decimals and converting repeating decimals into fractions. They used the subtraction method successfully for 0.363636… and 0.1666….
